response.message: No enemy comes from that side in this world
A raid goes 1 to 3 fields deep

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 1 rounds.

notifications.title: Your raid was beaten at the Monster Lair
notifications.body: It turns for home with 69 resources; 4 of its men fell.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 9 of them against its guard of 30.

notifications.title: Your raid was beaten at the Olive Groves
notifications.body: It turns for home with 0 resources; 2 of its men fell.

notifications.title: Your raid won the battle of the Frozen Marsh
notifications.body: 8 of the enemy fell; it carries 69 resources and a Svarog's Ember and marches on.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-8, 2)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2800 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (2, -2) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-7, 5)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2450 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The boatwrights at (-6, 4) gave up and left
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (2, -2)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 2100 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: The captives at (2, -1) were taken away

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, -1)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.
